title: Global items Logical/Physical Min/Max should be read as signed, not unsigned
body:
In section 6, under "To parse the report descriptor, run the following steps:", under "If item is a [Global item](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-global-items):", the spec has these items:
> 1. Let globalState be the last [item](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item) of globalStack.
> 2. Let value be the [item data field](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-item-data-field) interpreted as an unsigned long.
> 3. If item has the [Usage Page tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-usage-page-tag), then set globalState["[usagePage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidcollectioninfo-usagepage)"] to value.
> 4. If item has the [Logical Minimum tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-logical-minimum-tag), then set globalState["[logicalMinimum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-logicalminimum)"] to value.
> 5. If item has the [Logical Maximum tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-logical-maximum-tag), then set globalState["[logicalMaximum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-logicalmaximum)"] to value.
> 6. If item has the [Physical Minimum tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-physical-minimum-tag), then set globalState["[physicalMinimum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-physicalminimum)"] to value.
> 7. If item has the [Physical Maximum tag](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-physical-maximum-tag), then set globalState["[physicalMaximum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-physicalmaximum)"] to value.

However, according to the HID spec section 5.8 and 6.2.2.7, the Logical Minimum/Maximum and Physical Minimum/Maximum should be interpreted as signed. (for example, the example of a mouse descriptor in section 6.2.2.7 has negative values for the Logical Minimum and Physical Minimum)
